title: Build HCP Co nanowire atomistic models
action: Construct atomistic models of HCP Co nanowires as 'cubic hexagons' with side dimensions d from ~2 nm to ~8 nm. Lattice constants a=2.507 Å, c/a for HCP. Generate input coordinate files for each size.
description: Prepare simulation-ready geometry files for all nanowire sizes.

title: Run molecular dynamics simulations
action: For each nanowire model, run MD simulation using LAMMPS with the Co EAM potential: energy minimization, free relaxation (NPT, zero external stress), then uniaxial tension along axial direction at low constant strain rate. Record per-atom stresses (SPH) and global stress–strain and transverse strain data.
description: Execute MD workload to produce the necessary trajectories and stress data.

title: Extract size-dependent elastic constants
action: From the MD stress–strain data for each side dimension d, compute axial Young's modulus E as the linear slope of the axial stress–strain curve, and Poisson's ratio ν as negative ratio of transverse strain to axial strain in the same linear regime. Output a CSV with columns d_nm, E_GPa, nu.
description: Report size-dependent axial elastic modulus and Poisson's ratio for the cubic-hexagon nanowires.
output_schema: CSV with header: d_nm, E_GPa, nu. d_nm is side dimension in nm; E_GPa is a float; nu is a float.

title: Compute cross-sectional normal stress distribution
action: For a representative side dimension (e.g., any size where the pattern is clear), from the free-relaxation configuration extract per-atom stress tensors, bin along a transverse direction to obtain profile of axial normal stress σ_zz as a function of position across the nanowire cross-section. Output a CSV with columns position_nm, sigma_zz_GPa.
description: Characterise the inhomogeneous self-balancing stress field at zero external load.
output_schema: CSV with header: position_nm, sigma_zz_GPa. position_nm is distance from wire centre (nm); sigma_zz_GPa is the average normal stress in GPa at that position.
